purpose: development-only inference-time schedule screening after the existing C3 baseline audit

invariants.checkpoint: existing controlled clean-v2 checkpoint; no retraining
invariants.data: unchanged clean-v2 data and unique6 views

new_schedule_family.name: LLH_ramp_eq
new_schedule_family.definition: fixed-low for first 33 steps; linear ramp from 1.25 to 3.6029411764705883 over final 17 steps
new_schedule_family.purpose: test whether a smooth late high avoids the abrupt LLH transition while preserving nominal budget

new_schedule_family.name: LLH_cosine_eq
new_schedule_family.definition: fixed-low until the final third; cosine half-ramp from 1.25 with peak 3.6029411764705883 over final 17 steps
new_schedule_family.purpose: test a smooth late-peaked schedule at the same nominal scale budget

promotion_gate.primary: new schedule must have paired 95% FG-LPIPS CI strictly below zero versus both C3_TCAS and fixed_low
promotion_gate.guardrails: report PSNR, FG-SSIM, Edge-SSIM and FG-MAE; any unfavorable guardrail is retained and not hidden
promotion_gate.failure_action: do_not_promote; do not run strict 276 or Exact 76 for this candidate
promotion_gate.interpretation: development screening only; passing does not create a CAI winner or a cross-backbone claim

provenance.main_worktree_policy: do not modify the frozen main-adapter or MV-Adapter artifacts
